title: Add: a delivery note on orders
prompt: Buyers can leave a delivery note (optional, up to 500 characters) when they create an order. Store it on the order and return it in the order details.
done: creating an order accepts an optional delivery note of up to 500 characters, the order stores it, and GET /api/orders/{orderId} returns it

expect.text: The Domain designer's Order has the delivery note: an optional string with max length 500.
The Services designer's create order request or command has the optional delivery note field.
The Services designer's order details contract (the type GET /api/orders/{orderId} returns) has the delivery note.
